notes: Random target records (kind 0..7 or random, positions on or off the map), group records (types 2, 0xa, 3, 1 or random) and home positions; random stack words for the home heading and first entry, escort counts 0..3, 0xff or random. Both waypoint lists are random, with midpoints sometimes inside the clamp range. 0xa45b3 returns random words (and clobbers EDX), 0xb4e48 logs its arguments and returns -1, small or random indices, and 0xb513c logs its arguments, sometimes repoints group+0x20 at the second list and clobbers EAX/EBX/ECX/EDX.
